scriptures.verse: “Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.”
“I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.”
“But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.”
“Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.”
“And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.”
“The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.”

beliefs.title: The Word of God
beliefs.text: The Holy Bible is the inspired, infallible and authoritative Word of God — our final guide for faith and daily living.

beliefs.title: God the Father
beliefs.text: There is one God, the Creator and Father of all, who is infinite, holy and full of love toward His children.

beliefs.title: Jesus Christ
beliefs.text: Jesus is the Son of God, born of a virgin, crucified for our sins, risen on the third day and coming again in glory.

beliefs.title: The Holy Spirit
beliefs.text: The Holy Spirit indwells every believer, empowering us to live holy lives, witness boldly and walk in spiritual gifts.

beliefs.title: Salvation by Grace
beliefs.text: Salvation is a free gift of God received through faith in Jesus Christ — not by works, so no one can boast.

beliefs.title: Healing & Miracles
beliefs.text: God still heals and performs miracles today. We pray in faith, believing nothing is impossible with God.
